beginner.summary: For developers, operations engineers and analysts who are starting with Elasticsearch and the Elastic Stack (ELK). Covers the stack and its deployment options, a secured lab, documents, indices and mappings, Query DSL search, text analysis, aggregations, ES|QL, Kibana Discover and dashboards, Elastic Agent and Fleet, Beats and Logstash, ingest pipelines, data streams and lifecycle, cluster architecture, security, Kibana alerting, Elastic Observability, Elastic APM with OpenTelemetry, snapshots and troubleshooting. Written for Elastic Stack 9.x.
prerequisites: Comfortable with JSON and the command line
Knows what logs and HTTP APIs are
Has used Docker or a cloud console
outcomes: Index, search and aggregate data with mappings, analyzers, Query DSL and the Elasticsearch Query Language
Collect and parse logs and metrics with Elastic Agent, Beats, Logstash and ingest pipelines
Build Kibana dashboards, alerts and observability views
Run a secure cluster with lifecycle policies, snapshots and basic troubleshooting

days.topic: Elastic Stack Overview: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Beats and Elastic Agent
subtopics: How the ELK Stack became the Elastic Stack
Elasticsearch as a distributed search and analytics engine
Kibana for exploring and visualising data
Logstash and ingest pipelines for processing
Beats, Elastic Agent and Fleet for collection
Self-managed, Elastic Cloud Hosted and Serverless deployments
Licences: AGPL, SSPL, Elastic License and subscription tiers
Course project overview: logs, metrics and product search for a web shop
days.lab_task: Tour a running Elastic deployment, find the web shop logs in Discover, open a dashboard and draw a diagram that shows the job of each component.
checks: Web shop logs are found in Discover
Each component's role is correct on the diagram
Deployment options are compared for the course scenario

days.topic: Lab Setup: Elasticsearch and Kibana with Docker or Elastic Cloud
subtopics: Security on by default: TLS and the elastic user
Enrolling Kibana with an enrollment token
Elastic Cloud trial as an alternative
days.lab_task: Start Elasticsearch and Kibana with security enabled, enroll Kibana, load sample data, create an API key and check cluster health from Dev Tools and curl.
days.deliverable: Secured lab cluster with sample data and an API key
checks: Cluster health is green or yellow with security on
Kibana connects with an enrollment token
curl works with the API key

days.topic: Documents, Indices and Mappings
subtopics: Field types: text, keyword, numeric, date, boolean and geo
Reindexing when a mapping must change
days.lab_task: Index web shop products with dynamic mapping, find the mapping problems, fix them with an explicit mapping and an index template, and reindex.
days.deliverable: Product index with an explicit mapping and template
checks: Data moves to the new index without loss

days.topic: Search with Query DSL: Full-Text, Term and Bool Queries
subtopics: bool: must, should, filter and must_not
Pagination with from, size and search_after
days.lab_task: Build product searches that combine full-text matching with fuzziness, filters for price and category, sorting and highlighting, and explain why the top result ranks first.
checks: Full-text queries return relevant products, even with typos
Filters narrow results without changing scores
The top result's score is explained

days.topic: Text Analysis: Analyzers, Tokenizers and Synonyms
days.lab_task: Create a custom analyzer with a synonym set for product search, add search-as-you-type for product names and test both with the analyze API.
checks: The analyze API shows the expected tokens
A synonym search finds the product

days.topic: Aggregations: Metrics, Buckets and Pipelines
subtopics: Terms, histogram and date histogram buckets
days.lab_task: Answer five business questions about web shop orders with aggregations, including sales per day, top categories and the 95th percentile order value.
days.deliverable: Aggregation queries that answer five questions
checks: Each question has a working aggregation
A nested aggregation shows categories per day

days.topic: ES|QL: Piped Queries for Analysis
subtopics: FROM, WHERE, EVAL, STATS and SORT
ES|QL compared with Query DSL and KQL
days.lab_task: Use ES|QL to find the busiest hours, error rates per service and slow requests in the web shop logs, enrich the results with a lookup index of service owners and save the queries.
days.deliverable: Saved ES|QL queries with lookup enrichment
checks: Error rates per service are calculated
Each row includes the owning team
Queries are saved and reusable in Discover

days.topic: Kibana Discover, Visualisations and Dashboards
subtopics: Discover: KQL, filters and field statistics
days.lab_task: Build a web shop operations dashboard with Lens charts, a map of orders and controls for service and region, and share it in a team space.
days.deliverable: Operations dashboard in a team space
checks: The dashboard shows traffic, errors and orders
Team members open it in their space

days.topic: Collecting Logs with Elastic Agent, Fleet and Integrations
subtopics: Integrations for system, nginx and databases
Data stream naming: type, dataset and namespace
days.lab_task: Enroll agents on the web shop hosts with a policy that collects system, nginx and PostgreSQL logs and metrics, and confirm the data streams in Discover.
days.deliverable: Agent policy and incoming data streams
checks: Logs and metrics arrive in the expected data streams

days.topic: Beats and Logstash Pipelines
subtopics: Persistent queues and dead letter queues
When to use Logstash, ingest pipelines or Elastic Agent
days.lab_task: Ship legacy application logs with Filebeat to Logstash, parse them with grok and date filters, enrich them and send them to Elasticsearch with a dead letter queue for failures.
checks: Failed events land in the dead letter queue

days.topic: Ingest Pipelines and Processors in Elasticsearch
subtopics: grok, dissect, date and rename processors
The enrich processor and enrich policies
days.lab_task: Write an ingest pipeline that parses web server logs, adds GeoIP data and customer data from an enrich policy, and simulate it before setting it as the default pipeline.
days.deliverable: Tested ingest pipeline set as a default pipeline
checks: Documents gain location and customer fields
Bad lines are tagged instead of dropped

days.topic: Data Streams, Lifecycle and Storage Tiers
subtopics: Hot, warm, cold and frozen tiers
days.lab_task: Apply a lifecycle that rolls over web shop logs daily, moves them to warm after 7 days and to frozen after 30 days, deletes them after 90 days, and turn on logsdb mode.
checks: New backing indices are created on schedule
Older indices move to the right tier
Logsdb mode reduces storage for the same data

days.topic: Cluster Architecture: Nodes, Shards and Replicas
subtopics: Cluster health and the allocation explain API
days.lab_task: Grow the lab to three nodes with roles, set zone awareness, fix an unassigned shard with the allocation explain API and rebalance an uneven index.
checks: The cluster runs three nodes with roles

days.topic: Security: Users, Roles, API Keys and Field-Level Security
subtopics: Single sign-on with SAML or OIDC
days.lab_task: Create a role for support staff who see orders for their region without card fields, give a service an API key with least privilege and turn on audit logging.
days.deliverable: Roles, API keys and audit log
checks: Support staff cannot see card fields
The service key can only write to its data stream
Access attempts appear in the audit log

days.topic: Alerting and Cases in Kibana
days.lab_task: Create rules that alert on error spikes and missing data, send them to Slack and email with summaries, mute them during a maintenance window and open a case.
days.deliverable: Alert rules with connectors and a case
checks: An error spike triggers a notification
No alerts fire during the maintenance window
objectives: Alert on log and metric data

days.topic: Elastic Observability: Logs, Infrastructure and Service Views
days.lab_task: Monitor the web shop hosts and containers, add a synthetic check for checkout, define an SLO and use log rate analysis to explain an error spike.
days.deliverable: Observability setup with an SLO and a spike analysis
checks: Hosts and containers appear with metrics
The synthetic check fails when checkout breaks
Log rate analysis finds the field behind the spike

days.topic: Elastic APM and OpenTelemetry
subtopics: APM concepts: transactions, spans and errors
days.lab_task: Instrument two web shop services with EDOT, view the service map, find the slow span behind a latency problem and jump from the trace to its logs.
checks: The service map shows the dependency
The slow span is found and linked to its logs
objectives: Instrument services for Elastic with OpenTelemetry

days.topic: Snapshots, Backup and Restore
days.lab_task: Register an object storage repository, schedule daily snapshots with retention, delete an index by mistake and restore it to the original cluster and to a new one.
checks: The snapshot restores into a new cluster

days.topic: Troubleshooting Elasticsearch: Slow Queries, Heap and Red Clusters
subtopics: Slow logs for search and indexing
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, a red cluster, a slow query, a disk watermark block and a mapping explosion, fix each one and record the steps.
checks: Cluster health and query times return to normal
Each fix has a preventive setting or alert

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Log Analytics and Search for the Web Shop
days.lab_task: Deliver log analytics and product search for the web shop with agents and pipelines, a product index with custom analysis, dashboards, alerts, a lifecycle policy and least-privilege roles.
days.deliverable: Working web shop analytics and search with a demo
checks: Logs from every service are parsed and searchable
Product search handles synonyms and typos
Alerts, lifecycle and roles work as designed

intermediate.summary: For engineers who build search and observability on Elastic for several teams, at Elastic Certified Engineer level. Covers data modelling with nested, join and flattened fields, relevance tuning, semantic search with semantic_text and ELSER, hybrid search with retrievers and RRF, vector search with quantisation, search applications and query rules, sizing and performance, cross-cluster search and replication, Fleet and Logstash at scale, Kubernetes and cloud observability, machine learning jobs, Elastic Security as a SIEM, Workflows, the AI Assistant and Agent Builder, stack monitoring and AutoOps, upgrades from 8.x to 9.x and exam preparation.
prerequisites: Indexes, searches and aggregates data with Query DSL and the Elasticsearch Query Language
Runs agents, pipelines and lifecycle policies
outcomes: Model data and tune relevance for lexical, semantic and hybrid search
Size, tune and connect clusters with cross-cluster search and replication
Run Fleet, Logstash, observability, machine learning and SIEM use cases for teams
Automate with Workflows and agents, upgrade safely and prepare for the Elastic Certified Engineer exam

days.topic: Data Modelling for Search: Nested, Join and Flattened Fields
subtopics: The join field for parent-child data
Choosing a model by query pattern
days.lab_task: Model orders with line items three ways, as objects, nested fields and a join field, run the same five queries on each and choose a model with evidence.
days.deliverable: Three data models compared with a decision
checks: All three models index the same orders
Nested and join queries return correct line items
The chosen model is justified by query results and cost

days.topic: Relevance Tuning: Function Score, Boosting and Rank Evaluation
days.lab_task: Build a judgement list for twenty product queries, measure relevance with the rank evaluation API, tune boosts and recency, and show the score change.
days.deliverable: Judgement list, tuning changes and relevance scores
checks: Boosts and functions change the ranking as intended
The tuned NDCG beats the baseline

days.topic: Semantic Search: Embeddings, semantic_text and ELSER
subtopics: Inference endpoints and the Elastic Inference Service
days.lab_task: Add a semantic_text field backed by ELSER to the product catalogue, compare semantic and lexical results for ten natural-language queries and measure latency.
days.deliverable: Semantic product search with a comparison
checks: Semantic results win for natural-language queries
Query latency is recorded for both approaches

days.topic: Hybrid Search with Retrievers and Reciprocal Rank Fusion
days.lab_task: Combine lexical and semantic retrievers with RRF, add a reranking step, and compare lexical, semantic and hybrid relevance on the judgement list.
checks: The hybrid query returns fused results
Reranking changes the top results as expected
Hybrid relevance is measured against both single methods

days.topic: Vector Search at Scale: Dense Vectors, Quantisation and BBQ
days.lab_task: Index a million vectors with HNSW and with BBQ, measure memory, recall and latency for filtered kNN queries and recommend settings.
checks: Both index types hold the same vectors
Memory, recall and latency are compared
Settings are chosen from the measurements

days.topic: Search Applications: Search UI, Query Rules and Synonyms Management
subtopics: Query rules for pinned and excluded results
Synonyms sets managed through the API
Search API keys for front ends
days.lab_task: Build a product search front end with Search UI and a search template, add query rules for promotions, manage synonyms through the API and fix the top zero-result queries.
days.deliverable: Search front end with rules and synonym management
checks: The front end searches through a template with a restricted key
Top zero-result queries now return results

days.topic: Sizing Elasticsearch Clusters: Ingest, Retention and Search Load
subtopics: Sizing by ingest rate and retention
Tier sizing for hot, warm, cold and frozen
days.lab_task: Size a cluster for 2 TB a day of logs with 30 days hot and one year frozen, benchmark a reduced version with Rally and adjust the plan.
checks: The plan covers ingest, retention and search load
Rally results confirm or change the assumptions
Each tier has a cost estimate

days.topic: Performance Tuning: Indexing Throughput and Search Latency
subtopics: Refresh interval and replicas during loads
Expensive queries and how to avoid them
days.lab_task: Double indexing throughput for a bulk load and halve the latency of the three slowest dashboard queries, proving each change with measurements.

days.topic: Cross-Cluster Search and Cross-Cluster Replication
subtopics: Cross-cluster search with Query DSL and ES|QL
Security for remote clusters with API keys
days.lab_task: Connect two regional clusters, search both from one Kibana, replicate a critical index to the second region and promote the follower during a simulated outage.
days.deliverable: Connected clusters with replication and failover test
checks: One query returns results from both clusters

days.topic: Fleet at Scale: Agent Policies, Output Routing and Upgrades
subtopics: Policy design for many host groups
days.lab_task: Design policies for three host groups with different outputs, upgrade a fleet in stages with a rollback plan and alert on unhealthy agents.
checks: Each host group sends data to its output
Agents upgrade in stages without data gaps

days.topic: Logstash at Scale: Pipelines, Queues and Central Management
subtopics: Performance tuning with workers and batches
Replacing Logstash with ingest pipelines or agents
days.lab_task: Split a monolithic Logstash pipeline into distributor and per-source pipelines with persistent queues, manage them centrally and tune throughput.
checks: Each source has its own pipeline

days.topic: Elastic Observability for Kubernetes and Cloud Services
subtopics: Cloud integrations for AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Alerting on pod and node health
days.lab_task: Monitor a Kubernetes cluster and one cloud account with Elastic, alert on crash-looping pods and estimate the monthly telemetry volume.
days.deliverable: Kubernetes and cloud observability with alerts
checks: Cluster and cloud metrics and logs arrive
A crash-looping pod triggers an alert

days.topic: Machine Learning in Elastic: Anomaly Detection and Forecasting
days.lab_task: Create anomaly detection jobs for web shop traffic and errors, forecast next week's traffic and alert when the anomaly score passes 75.
checks: The forecast covers next week with bounds
High anomaly scores trigger an alert

days.topic: Elastic Security as a SIEM: Detection Rules and Investigations
subtopics: Custom rules with KQL, EQL and ES|QL
days.lab_task: Enable prebuilt rules for the web shop hosts, write an ES|QL rule for brute-force logins, investigate a seeded attack in Timeline and record it in a case.
checks: The attack path is reconstructed in Timeline
False positives are reduced with exceptions

days.topic: Workflows and Automation in Kibana
subtopics: Triggers from alerts, schedules and manual runs
Steps that query Elasticsearch and call connectors
days.lab_task: Build a workflow that runs when an error alert fires, gathers recent logs and deployments, posts a summary to Slack and opens a case with the findings.
days.deliverable: Alert-driven workflow with a test run
checks: The summary includes logs and deployments
A case opens with the findings

days.topic: Elastic AI Assistant and Agent Builder
subtopics: The AI Assistant for Observability and Security
Agent Builder: agents, tools and skills
days.lab_task: Build an agent with Agent Builder that answers questions about web shop errors with ES|QL tools, add a knowledge base of runbooks and test it on ten questions.
checks: The agent answers with data from its query tools
Answers cite runbooks from the knowledge base
At least eight of ten answers are correct

days.topic: Monitoring the Stack: Stack Monitoring, AutoOps and Metrics
days.lab_task: Send monitoring data to a separate cluster, connect AutoOps where available, alert on heap pressure and disk watermarks and read the health report.
checks: Monitoring data reaches the monitoring cluster
Heap and disk alerts fire on seeded conditions
The health report explains the cluster state

days.topic: Upgrades and Migrations: Rolling Upgrades from 8.x to 9.x
subtopics: Upgrade paths through the last 8.x minor
The Upgrade Assistant and deprecation logs
days.lab_task: Upgrade a three-node 8.x cluster to 9.x with the Upgrade Assistant, fix deprecations, roll nodes one by one and upgrade Kibana and agents without data loss.
days.deliverable: Upgraded cluster with an upgrade record
checks: Nodes upgrade one at a time with the cluster serving
Data and dashboards work after the upgrade

days.topic: Elastic Certified Engineer Exam Preparation
subtopics: Exam format: hands-on, performance-based tasks on a live cluster
The exam version: Elastic 9.3 from 1 September 2026
Data management tasks: indices, templates and lifecycle
Search tasks: Query DSL, aggregations and ES|QL
Cluster management tasks: allocation, snapshots and security
Using the documentation during the exam
days.lab_task: Complete a timed set of exam-style tasks on a practice cluster, record time and correctness per task and repeat the weakest area.
days.deliverable: Practice results and a second attempt
checks: All task areas are attempted under time limits
Time and correctness per task are recorded
The second attempt on the weakest area is faster
objectives: Prepare for the Elastic Certified Engineer exam

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Search and Observability Platform for Several Teams
subtopics: Fleet, Logstash and observability for teams
days.lab_task: Deliver an Elastic platform for three teams with hybrid product search, Fleet-managed collection, Kubernetes observability, anomaly jobs, SIEM rules, an alert workflow, stack monitoring and a tested upgrade plan.
checks: Hybrid search beats lexical search on the judgement list
Teams see their data, alerts and anomalies
Monitoring and the upgrade plan are tested

advanced.summary: For architects and platform owners who run Elastic across an organisation. Covers enterprise architecture, deployment models including Serverless and ECK, ECK operations, multi-tenancy, petabyte-scale logging, log processing with Streams and OpenTelemetry, metrics with time series data streams and PromQL, OpenTelemetry-native observability, SIEM architecture, search platform operations, RAG and agents, cross-region disaster recovery, hardening and compliance, performance engineering, cost management, application development with clients, migrations from Splunk and OpenSearch, governance and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Runs Elastic clusters for several teams in production
Comfortable with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and security controls
Responsible for platform design, cost or compliance
outcomes: Design Elastic architectures and deployment models for an organisation
Run logging, metrics, tracing and security analytics at petabyte scale with controlled cost
Build search, RAG and agent platforms on Elasticsearch
Govern, secure, migrate to and troubleshoot Elastic at scale

days.topic: Elastic Architecture for Large Organisations
subtopics: Clusters by use case, region and tenant
Shared services: monitoring, security and snapshots
days.lab_task: Design the Elastic estate for a company with search, observability and security teams in three regions, and defend the cluster layout in a design review.
checks: Clusters, regions and shared services are defined
Failure domains limit the impact of one cluster failing
The review records decisions and open risks

days.topic: Deployment Models: Serverless, Elastic Cloud Hosted, ECK and Self-Managed
days.lab_task: Compare the four deployment models for the course estate on control, features, cost and compliance, and choose a model for each workload.
checks: Each model is compared on four criteria
Costs are estimated for each choice
Each workload has a model with reasons

days.topic: Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes Operations
subtopics: The ECK operator and custom resources
days.lab_task: Deploy Elasticsearch, Kibana and Fleet with ECK, change a node set, upgrade the stack, enable autoscaling and recover from a lost pod.
checks: The stack runs from ECK resources
A node set change rolls out safely
The cluster heals after losing a pod

days.topic: Multi-Tenancy: Spaces, Index Naming and Tenant Isolation
subtopics: Tenancy models: shared, index-per-tenant and cluster-per-tenant
Kibana spaces and roles per tenant
Naming and data stream namespaces per tenant
days.lab_task: Onboard three tenants with automation, isolate their data with namespaces, roles and spaces, test isolation and report usage per tenant.
days.deliverable: Automated tenant onboarding and isolation tests
checks: Each tenant is created by automation
Tenants cannot see each other's data

days.topic: Petabyte-Scale Logging: Frozen Tier, Logsdb and Cost Control
subtopics: Ingest at hundreds of terabytes a day
Cost per gigabyte stored and searched
days.lab_task: Design retention tiers for 200 TB a day of logs, measure storage savings from logsdb and the latency of frozen-tier searches, and report cost per gigabyte.
days.deliverable: Logging design with storage and cost measurements
checks: Each log type has a retention tier
Logsdb savings and frozen search latency are measured
Cost per gigabyte is reported per tier

days.topic: Log Processing with Streams, Ingest Pipelines and OpenTelemetry Processors
subtopics: Where to process logs: edge, collector or cluster
Streams in Elastic Observability for routing and parsing
Schema decisions: ECS and OpenTelemetry semantic conventions
days.lab_task: Route and parse three log sources with Streams or ingest pipelines and the EDOT Collector, keep failed documents for repair and change one parser safely.
days.deliverable: Log processing design with a tested change
checks: Each source lands in its own stream
Failed documents are kept and fixed
A parser change goes live without data loss

days.topic: Metrics at Scale: Time Series Data Streams, Downsampling and PromQL
subtopics: Prometheus remote write and PromQL support in Elastic
days.lab_task: Store service metrics in a time series data stream, downsample older data, query it with PromQL and ES|QL and compare storage with a plain data stream.
checks: Metrics land in a time series data stream
Old data is downsampled on schedule
PromQL and Elasticsearch Query Language results match
objectives: Query metrics with PromQL and the Elasticsearch Query Language

days.topic: OpenTelemetry-Native Observability with the EDOT Collector
subtopics: EDOT Collector modes: agent and gateway
days.lab_task: Move two services from Elastic APM agents to EDOT SDKs, run EDOT Collectors as agents and a gateway, and confirm traces, metrics and logs still correlate.
checks: Traces, metrics and logs still link

days.topic: Security Analytics at Scale: SIEM Architecture and Detection Engineering
days.lab_task: Build a detection engineering pipeline that tests and deploys rules from Git, measure rule performance on a large dataset and review attack discovery results.
checks: Rules deploy from Git after tests
Rule run times stay within limits

days.topic: Search Platform Architecture: Relevance Operations and A/B Tests
days.lab_task: Run an A/B test of two ranking configurations behind aliases, collect click data, decide the winner and reindex with zero downtime.
days.deliverable: A/B test result and zero-downtime release
checks: The winner is chosen with significance

days.topic: RAG and Agents on Elasticsearch
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant over company documents with hybrid retrieval and document-level security, expose it through Agent Builder and MCP, and evaluate retrieval and answers.
days.deliverable: Secured RAG assistant with an evaluation

days.topic: Disaster Recovery Across Regions: Replication, Snapshots and Failover
subtopics: Recovery objectives for search and logs
days.lab_task: Fail the primary region in a test, promote replicated indices, restore Kibana objects, point agents at the standby and measure achieved RPO and RTO.
days.deliverable: Recovery test with achieved RPO and RTO
checks: Replicated indices serve traffic in the standby region
Dashboards and rules work in the standby region
Achieved RPO and RTO are recorded

days.topic: Security Hardening and Compliance: Encryption, Audit and Retention
subtopics: Encryption in transit and at rest
days.lab_task: Harden a cluster against a checklist, redact personal data at ingest, set retention that meets a deletion duty and produce compliance evidence.
checks: The cluster passes the hardening checklist
Personal data is removed before indexing
Evidence shows retention and audit controls

days.topic: Performance Engineering at Scale: Shard Strategy and Query Optimisation
subtopics: Load testing with Rally at scale
days.lab_task: Re-plan shards for the largest data streams, rewrite the five slowest dashboard queries and prove the gains with Rally at production scale.
days.deliverable: Shard plan and query rewrites with benchmarks
checks: Slow queries meet the dashboard budget
Rally confirms the gains at scale

days.topic: Cost Management: Tiering, Compression and Licence Planning
subtopics: Cost drivers: compute, storage and licences
days.lab_task: Cut the estate's annual cost by 25% with tiering, logsdb and data reduction while keeping required features, and present showback per team.

days.topic: Building Applications with Elasticsearch Clients
subtopics: Official clients for Python, Java, JavaScript, Go and .NET
API keys and security for applications
days.lab_task: Build a small service with an official client that bulk-loads data, searches through a template with an API key, retries safely and is tested against a container.
checks: Bulk loading handles failures and retries
Templates are called with the restricted key
Integration tests run against a container

days.topic: Migrating to Elastic from Splunk or OpenSearch
subtopics: Automatic migration of Splunk rules and dashboards in Elastic Security
days.lab_task: Migrate a set of Splunk searches and detection rules to Elastic, move sample data from OpenSearch, run both in parallel and compare results.
checks: Searches and rules produce matching results

days.topic: Governance: Data Ownership, Naming Standards and Self-Service Onboarding
subtopics: Infrastructure as code with the Terraform provider
days.lab_task: Write naming and field standards, build self-service onboarding for a new data source with Terraform and quotas, and retire three unused data streams.
checks: New data streams follow the naming standard
A team onboards a source without a ticket
Unused data streams are removed with owner approval

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Cluster Instability, Memory and Network Partitions
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded master instability, heap pressure and a network partition on a large test cluster with diagnostics bundles, fix them and write an incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, fixes and an incident review
checks: Each failure's cause is shown with evidence
The cluster stays stable under load after the fixes
objectives: Write a post-incident review of a cluster incident with the root cause and a preventive action

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Company-Wide Elastic Platform Design
subtopics: Logging, metrics and security at scale
days.lab_task: Present a company-wide Elastic platform to a review board with the architecture and deployment models, petabyte-scale logging and metrics design, SIEM and search platforms, recovery test results, cost plan and governance model.
days.deliverable: Platform design with evidence and a board decision
checks: Architecture and deployment choices pass review
Recovery and performance claims have test evidence
Cost and governance plans have owners
